reviewMethod: Independent read-only harness review, sanitized JSON assertions, and visual review of all seven Atlas screenshot captures; reviewer performed no network, credential, database, or browser actions

verified.positiveMutations: One fixture created, its title/note updated while preserving ID/createdAt, then deleted

limits: No MongoDB-driver connection or BSON digest was used in this run. Atlas evidence is complete unfiltered visible E-JSON for an empty/single-record collection, compared at action-batch boundaries.
App readbacks were checked after each negative request; Atlas was checked after each four-request negative batch, not after every individual request.
Three positive controls ran on the production alias; the other three hosts were confirmed to map to the same deployment and received negative requests only.
The final Atlas observation is a separate post-revocation acknowledgment, not an in-harness acknowledgment.
Local serializer/runtime package versions were verified against the deployed commit lockfile. This does not measure the exact Vercel Node patch.
Observed first-attempt non-200 and second-attempt initial302,302,200 responses do not establish the cause of initial authorization delay.
This bounded test does not prove absence of side effects outside bookmark_app.bookmarks or future protection against every request shape.

checkedClaims: Twelve anonymous requests and three positive controls are tied to exact deployment/source commit
Atlas comparisons are complete visible E-JSON at batch boundaries, not BSON or per-request database digests
Six in-harness acknowledgments plus one separate final post-revocation observation support seven checkpoints
First failed attempt and both token revocations are disclosed
Historical access limitation remains dated and marked superseded
Private publication access/reminder requirements and unresolved development audit findings remain unchanged
